Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. India have started the series on a high and they will look to continue in similar fashion. Australia on the other hand will look to come back with a bang when they play the hosts again in Kolkata on the 21st of September for the 2nd ODI. Hope you liked our coverage for this game. Until then, goodbye and cheers!

Man of the Match, Hardik Pandya says that it was a good day for him. Reckons that the runs under the belt and some wickets too have helped him a lot. States that nothing has changed in the last year and emphasis on the fact that he is still the same. (When asked about his 24 runs over against Adam Zampa) Mentions that he knew what Zampa was going to bowl, so that made the job easy for him with Dhoni on the other end. Credits his coach and his teammates for always supporting him.

VIRAT KOHLI, the Indian skipper, says that they wanted to put up a good score but they couldn't get a good start. Credits Dhoni and Pandya for their innings and lauds Kumar's efforts with the bat. Is pleased with the fact that the lower order have done well in the limited opportunities that they have got. About Pandya he says that self belief is the key for him and that works well for the team. Feels that he was the game changer today as he did well both with the bat and the ball. Mentions that the spinners bowled exceedingly well. Ends saying that it's a complete team performance as even the pacers did well and since they have a good T20 bowling attack they were relaxed in the rain break as well.

STEVEN SMITH, the Australian skipper, says that they were in a good position at the start but MS Dhoni and Hardik Pandya played really well to take the game away from them. Reckons that it became really difficult to bat while chasing. Mentions that they cannot do anything about the weather, so won't complaint about it. Credits his new ball bowlers for bowling really well and hopes that they continue with it throughout the series. States that it was really tough batting to the new ball as there was some vibrant movement.

Earlier, India were rescued from a precarious position thanks to a wonderful knock by MS Dhoni. Hardik Pandya gave him good company for a while before teeing off later. The Australians couldn't really recover from that and the rains added to their plight, as they had to wait for their turn to bat. They also had to get out on the ground and go back almost immediately. It was a win which would please the home team's management. Stay tuned as we get you the presentation in a while.

A win which Virat Kohli will be happy with! Shortened targets are often favourable to the chasing sides but on this occasion, it's a different tale. India were always on the money by picking up regular wickets upfront. Once the visitors lost Smith and Head early, they were on the back foot. Warner's dismissal soon probably sealed it for them in the mind. Maxwell did give them some hope by belting the Indian spinners all over the park, but once he was gone, their chances vanished.
That's it! INDIA WIN THE GAME BY 26 RUNS (DLS Method) to take a 1-0 lead in the series! Fires a yorker just in line of the stumps, Zampa squeezes it out towards short fine leg for a single.
Another full ball outside off, Faulkner smashes that straight over the bowler's head for a single towards long off.

Fuller delivery outside off, Zampa lofts that over the cover region. Jadhav comes steaming in from the deep, dives forward but fails to reach the ball. Stops the ball and the batsmen run three in the process.

Fuller delivery around off, Faulkner drives it towards long on. Zampa wants the second but Kohli is quick to the ball. Faulkner sends him back but Zampa is halfway down the track. Kohli's throw from the deep ends up hitting Faulkner at the non-striker's end and Virat is not really happy about it.
Wide! Wide outside off, Faulkner lets it through to the keeper.

NOT OUT! Length delivery outside off, Faulkner swings his bat across. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball lobs towards MS Dhoni. The keeper dives forward and gobbles it but none of him or the umpire is sure if he has caught it. The umpire goes upstairs to check it. Replays show that it went on the bounce into Dhoni's gloves.
There is an appeal for caught behind! The umpire goes upstairs to check if the catch by MS Dhoni is clean!
Length delivery outside off, slogged towards deep mid-wicket. No runs taken there.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl the final over for India.
Fuller outside off, Zampa stays in his crease and drives it towards the fielder at extra cover. Australia need 34 runs of the last over.
Slower delivery outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller length delivery outside off, dabbed towards point for a single.
Fuller outside off, drilled towards long off for a single.
Adam Zampa is the last man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Good length delivery around off, Coulter-Nile stays deep in his crease and swipes across the line. The ball flies straight towards Kedar Jadhav at deep mid-wicket who pouches it safely. He celebrates it with Rohit Sharma in the deep and India are sensing victory here. The hosts need a wicket here to win.
Wide! Bowls this one wide outside off, a bit too wide as the umpire signals it as a wide. No need to bowl those!
Hurls a fuller delivery outside off, Faulkner heaves it towards wide long on for a single.
BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR is back into the attack.
Bowls it full outside off, NCN uses all his might yet ends up connecting with only the thin air! 39 required of 12 now!
Slower ball outside off, Coulter-Nile looks to smash that and ends up missing the ball.
Another low full toss around middle, driven to long on for a run.
Bowls it outside off, played through covers for a run.
Deep square leg comes in and long leg drops back.
Bowls a full toss in a bid to go for the yorker, Faulkner drives it straight back. The ball ricochets off the stumps at the non-striker's end and goes towards mid-wicket. The batsmen run one.
FOUR! Edgy stuff! Bumrah spears this on a length outside off, Faulkner slashes at that. Gets a thick edge through where a slip would have been. Races away to the fence for a boundary.
JASPRIT BUMRAH back on!
Floats it around off, slog swept to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses this around middle and leg, Faulkner misses the flick and wears it on the pads.
Floats it around off and middle, Nathan plays it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fires this in line of the stumps, James goes back and flicks it through mid on for a run.
SIX! Bang goes James! Chahal tosses this up outside off, Faulkner gets down on one knee and bashes it over the bowler's end for a maximum!

OUT! Chahal is spinning the Aussies to doom! He tosses this around off, Cummins looks to go over mid-wicket, ends up getting the top edge that flies straight to short third man. Bumrah there settles under it and pouches that safely. Australia slip further! The end is nigh!
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Fuller delivery around off, clipped through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Angling into the batsman, Cummins makes room and punches it through the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Short delivery and gets the punishment! Bangs it around off, Cummins camps back and smashes that over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fires a yorker in line of the stumps, Faulkner just manages to get his bat down in time. Squirts towards square leg for a single.
Good length delivery around off, punched back past the bowler for a single towards mid on.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Faulkner drives it towards the mid on region. The fielder comes rushing in towards the ball. Fails to pick it up and the batsmen end up running three in the process.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back into the attack.
Floats it around off, Cummins sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

DROPPED! Rahane the culprit this time! Chahal flights this around off, Cummins smashes it straight to long off. Rahane runs to his right, gets there but spills the chance! Another life for the Aussie finisher!
Loops it outside off, Cummins looks to cut that but gets an outside edge past slip for a brace.
Googly to welcome him! Cummins fails to read that and gets beaten on the inside. The ball passes just over the stumps.
Pat Cummins is the next man in.

OUT! An India game is incomplete without a MS Dhoni stumping! Chahal bowls a loopy wrong 'un wide outside off, Wade charges down to hit that but doesn't read the delivery. Dhoni collects it and whips the bails off in a flash. The third umpire is referred to. Replays show that Wade is short of the crease. Wide signaled by the umpire.
The umpires have gone upstairs to check for a stumping appeal against Matthew Wade. MS Dhoni is really confident there and Wade has already started walking back.

DROPPED! Chahal floats it outside off, Faulkner looks to slog sweep that. Ends up getting a top edge to the left of the bowler. Yuzvendra gets there but fails to catch that. The ball goes towards deep covers and the batsmen run one. Will this prove costly?
Tosses it outside off, Faulkner makes room and hits it straight back. Chahal stops it in his followthrough!
Short ball around off, pulled to square leg.

Ouch! That might have hurt! Back of a length slower delivery around leg, Wade looks to hoick it over mid-wicket. Is early into the shot and ends up getting hit on the chin. The ball rolls next to the stumps after that.
WIDE! Hardik bowls this down the leg side. Wade looks to scoop it but misses. Wide signaled.
This ball around off is punched through covers for a run.

Full ball around middle and leg at 141 kmph, Faulkner flicks it through backward square leg and sets off for a run. The fielder in the deep had to cover some ground to get to the ball before which James comes back for  the second.
Bowls it around off, Wade plays it through cover-point for a run.
Bowls a length ball down the leg side, Wade gets his bat and flicks it through backward square leg for a brace.
HARDIK PANDYA is brought back for another spell.
Quicker and drifting into the pads, Faulkner goes for the sweep but fails to make contact.
Floats a googly outside off, spinning into Wade this time. He goes for the slog sweep and ends up top edging towards the vacant short third man region for a single.
Flatter and spinning into the batsman from around leg, Wade fails to clip it through. Gets hit on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire is not interested in it.
FOUR! Shot! Around middle and leg, Wade comes down the track and swipes it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.

Dropped! Floats it around off, Wade comes down the track and smacks that straight back to the bowler. Chahal gets his right hand to it but fails to grab it. Tries to catch it again on the second attempt but fails. A tough chance goes down.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wrong 'un from Yadav and that wraps Wade on the pads. Matthew cannot flick it this time and the players appeal. The umpire is not interested. Height might have been the factor there.
Again into the pads, Faulkner flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
JAMES FAULKNER walks in at the fall of the 6th wicket!

OUT! Kuldeep Yadav strikes! Floats this one in the line of the stumps, Stoinis shuffles way across and finds himself in an uncomfortable position. Still goes for the slog sweep and ends up ballooning it towards the deep mid-wicket region. Jadeja the substitute fielder gets underneath it and takes a fine catch. Stoinis' struggle in the middle comes to an end.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

MS Dhoni misses a stumping! This is one of the rarest things that happen on a cricket field! Bowls a wrong 'un outside off, Stoinis comes down the track and goes for a big one. Fails to make contact as the ball goes straight to the keeper. Dhoni fails to collect the ball as he tries to dislodge the bails.
Matthew Wade is the next man in.

OUT! Chahal takes a really big wicket here! Totally against the run of play this time! Floats this around off, Maxwell gets under it and smacks that straight towards the fielder at long on. Pandey settles himself under it and takes it safely. The turn that Chahal got there, meant that Glenn couldn't get it off the middle of the bat. A brilliant cameo from Maxwell comes to an end and Kuldeep Yadav will be the happiest man on the ground.
SIX! Kaboom! Quicker into the pads, Maxwell goes the conventional way this time. Smashes that over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Maxwell goes for the reverse sweep, Chahal sees that movement and fires it wide outside off. Gets beaten and Dhoni gets his pads in the way to stop it.
Floated outside off, Maxwell dances down the track and mistimes his drive back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Full toss in line of the stumps, Maxwell kneels down and goes for the sweep. Goes straight to Sharma and he appeals for a catch. The umpires go upstairs. Replays show that it went on a bounce to him.
Rohit Sharma is claiming a catch. The umpires talk a bit and go upstairs. The soft signal is not out.
Fuller around leg, Stoinis makes room and drives it through covers for a single.
Bowls a wrong 'un outside off, Maxwell goes for the reverse sweep but he fails to make contact.
SIX! Three in a row! Brutal Maxi at his best! A bit short this time from Kuldeep and Maxwell is ready for the pull. He kneels down a touch and smashes that over the square leg region for a maximum.
SIX! Maxwell is doing to Kuldeep what Pandya did to Zampa! Another biggie and Maxi is on a loop. Fuller around off, Glenn gets under it and smacks that straight down the ground for half a dozen.
SIX! That's the Maxwell we know! Tossed up around middle and off, Glenn gets under it and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie.
FOUR! Freebies! Short and wide down the leg side, Maxwell is never going to miss out on those. He just stays back and pulls it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Maxwell cannot connect! Floats this one outside off, spinning into the batsman, Glenn goes for the reverse sweep but fails to make contact.
Change of ends for KULDEEP YADAV!
Tossed up fuller outside off, Stoinis drives it towards covers. Pandya misfields and allows the batsmen to pick up a couple.
Stoinis gets behind the line of the ball to defend it. Finally reads that well.
Fuller into the pads, Marcus sweeps it towards the fielder at short fine leg.

LBW appeal turned down! A bit quicker around off, spinning in. Stoinis fails to defend it and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested. India have no reviews left and replays show that the impact was outside off. Stoinis stays to battle on.

Safe! That was pretty close and that has to be the case when Dhoni appeals! Floats it outside off, sharp away turn undoes Stoinis who tries to defend it. Gets beaten and MS behind the stumps is quick to dislodge the bails. The umpire goes upstairs to check it. Replays show that Stoinis had his foot just back in time.
MS Dhoni is quick to dislodge the bails and appeal. The umpire has gone upstairs to check for a stumping appeal against Marcus Stoinis!
Drops that really short and angling into the batsman, Stoinis fails to push it on the leg side.
YUZVENDRA CHAHAL is called into the attack.
Short delivery just outside off, Maxwell swings his bat but only makes contact with thin air. 10 runs off the over.
FOUR! Length delivery angling into the stumps, Maxwell is done with his leaves. Swipes hard at it and gets it through the mid-wicket region for another boundary.
FOUR! Shot, Maxi! Short delivery outside off, Maxwell stays in his crease. Waits for it and slaps it just over the backward point fielder for a boundary.

In the air...safe! Slower delivery outside off, Maxwell goes for the biggie. Gets it off the bottom half and the ball balloons just over the mid on region. Neither the mid on nor the long off fielder can reach it. The batsmen run a couple.
Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, dug out back to the bowler.
Short delivery around middle and leg, Maxwell sways away and wait, he lets it through to the keeper. Strange thing when Glenn is on strike.
MARCUS STOINIS is the next man in. Needs to play a knock like he did against New Zealand.

OUT! David Warner is gone nicking! India are ecstatic, Chennai is ecstatic and why not! Yadav bowls it just outside off, this one didn't turn. The Aussie opener looks to cut but ends up getting the faintest of nicks to Dhoni who doesn't miss many. This is a big wicket as he has the ability to take the game away from the opposition before they realise. India on top here!
Beautifully bowled! Kuldeep tosses this one outside off, drawing Warner forward. The ball spins away and beats the bat.
Floats it around off, Warner defends it off the front foot onto the ground.
This delivery around off is played towards mid-wicket.

Good fielding by Chahal there! Yadav loops it around off and middle, Warner gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg. Chahal rushes to his left from deep square leg, puts in the dive and parries the ball to Kumar. They end up saving a couple of runs for the side.
Kuldeep bowls it short around off, Warner stays back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball outside off, Maxwell slashes it through cover-point for a run.
Bowls it on the pads, Warner works it through square leg for a run.
The big hitting GLENN MAXWELL is the next man in.

OUT! Pandya on a roll! Gets his second, with another knuckle ball! He bowls it on a length outside off, Head stays in the crease and looks to play it through the off side. Ends up nicking that to the keeper, Dhoni is more than happy to pouch that. Hardik raises his arms in celebration. So the pair that bailed India with the bat combine for this dismissal. Australia three down early in the piece!
Back of a length ball around leg, Warner pulls it aerially towards short fine leg. A fumble there by Kuldeep allows him a single.
Bowls it on the pads, Warner flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Bowls it around off, Head collects a single after playing it through covers.
This ball is driven to long on for a run.
A tad shorter around off, Head slashes it past point for a brace.
This is bowled on the pads, Warner nudges it round the corner for a run.
Floats it around off, Warner reverse sweeps it to short third man.
A tad shorter outside off, Head cuts that through point for a run to get off the mark.
Begins with a loopy ball around off, Head defends it off the front foot.
Kuldeep Yadav is brought into the attack.
Travis Head walks out to the middle.

OUT! Smith departs, Chepauk erupts! So the previous half-life not really proving to be costly. Pandya bowls a knuckle ball on a length around middle, Steven is early into the shot as he looks to pull it. Ends up getting a top edge that flies towards fine leg. Bumrah runs back from short fine leg and takes a brilliantly judged catch. India get two quick ones and this wicket is really big in the context of the game!

NOT OUT! Smith survives, India lose their review! Pandya spears it on a length around off, Smith looks to flick but wears it on the pads. Indians appeal to no avail. Hardik persuades his skipper to go for the review which Kohli does. Snicko doesn't spot an edge. Hawk Eye shows that it would have clipped the off stump. So the Aussie skipper bats on as the on-field call stays.
Close? An LBW decision against Smith is given not out by the umpire. It is reviewed by India.
Length ball around middle, Warner hits it aerially over mid-wicket. He gets three runs before the fielder from square leg fields that.
Smith gets going with a trademark wristy flick. Pandya lands it on a length around off, the skipper shuffles and plays it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it around off, Smith plays it to point.
Pandya starts off with a length ball around off, Warner flat-bats it to long on for a run.
Hardik Pandya is brought into the attack. Can he repeat his heroic performance with the ball as well?
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Aaah! Beaten! Bumrah bowls it on a length outside off, Smith goes for the cut but finds the ball pass just over the edge of the bat. Excellent delivery that.
Steven Smith strides out to bat.

OUT! Bowled him! Cartwright's stay at the crease comes to an end. Bumrah bowls a back of a length ball around off, Hilton looks to pull instinctively. The ball doesn't rise as much as he expected and he ends up finding his woodwork disturbed. That hit the top of off stump. Chepauk cheers loudly and why not! Bumrah has drawn first blood and this is the start India needed.
Landed in line of the stumps, David flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball around off, Warner plays it to point off the back foot. He's frustrated with himself for not being able to fine the gap on that occasion.
Bowls it on a length around middle, Warner defends it from the crease.
Length ball around middle and leg, Cartwright misses the ball and gets hit high on the thighs. The ball rolls to the off side and the batsmen steal a leg bye.
Another knuckle ball to end the over. Warner stays in the crease and blocks that.
This delivery is pushed towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! That's bread and butter for Warner! Back of a length ball on the pads, David stands tall and pulls it through backward square leg. The deep square leg fielder rushes to his left, puts in the dive yet is unable to prevent the boundary.

Edged but safe! Kumar lands it on a length around off, Cartwright pushes at that from the crease. Gets an inside edge that lands short of the diving slip fielder Rohit Sharma. He parries it towards point as Hilton crosses over for a run. First ODI run for him.
Beaten! Cartwright is cut into two halves! Kumar bowls a length ball around off that jars into the batsman after pitching. Hilton looks to push it but gets beaten on the inside.
Bowls a knuckle ball outside off, Warner goes for the wild slash. Gets an outside edge towards deep backward point for a run.
Fine leg inside the circle and square leg at the boundary in place.
This is bowled around off, Hilton hits it towards covers.
Bowled on the pads, Hilton misses the flick. The ball takes the pad and goes to Dhoni who dives and collects that.
Beauty! Bumrah bowls a length ball just outside off, which moves away just a bit, after pitching. Cartwright has a feel for that and sees the ball pass the edge of his bat. Wonderfully bowled.
Bowls a length ball around off and middle, Cartwright gets behind and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball on the pads, David flicks it away through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! David drives! Bumrah runs over the wicket and bowls it full around middle, Warner presents a straight bat and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball.
Length ball around off, David jumps and pushes it to the right of point for a quick run to get off the mark.
A knuckle ball bowled a tad fuller around off, Warner mistimes his drive towards covers.
This is bowled on a length around off, Warner hits it to the fielder at point.
Spears this on a length around middle and leg, David pushes it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Kumar sprays this down the leg side, Warner misses the flick. Wide signaled.
Back of a length delivery this time, Warner jumps and keeps it down from the crease.
Runs in from over the wicket and bowls a back of a length ball around middle and leg, Warner jumps and bunts it towards mid-wicket.
Revised target for Australia is 164 from 21 overs.

The men who matter make their way to the middle. There's still a very slight drizzle there. DAVID WARNER and HILTON CARTWRIGHT to open with the bat. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start the proceedings with the ball for India. Here we go....
